mission: READ-ONLY forensic audit — hard-refresh duplicates + Studio choppiness

problem1_duplicates.verdict: LIVE_HARD_REFRESH: feed data is single-row; visible duplicates are layout projection + per-card double title labels. Latent cross-shelf feed remount exists in distributeToShelves.

console.CANONICAL_FEED_UPSERT: action=update; removedTwins=1 (primary match strip+replace, not evidence of twin)

pipelineTrace.finding: feed store starts writable({}); durable key reelforge_feed is written by syncFromVault, not used as authoritative boot hydrate before sync.
GET /api/reels → buildHomeFeed → prune → feed.set(tombstoneSafeFeed). Backend-reachable path does NOT call distributeVideoToFeed here.
Video dedupe is exact raw URL string only (seenVideoUrls). Does not normalize absolute vs relative. Does not call collapseSameShelfDuplicateIdentities.

INTENTIONAL FEED DATA REMOUNT: when primary shelf !== Trending, identity is pushed to primary AND copied onto Trending with _onTrendingAsDiscovery. Creates cross-shelf duplicate feed records for same assetId.
Phase 6.6.2 upsert via findCanonicalFeedMatch; runs later via syncVideoVaultToFeed (~200ms after mount). Collapses same-identity matches when vault sync runs.
Featured remounts first unique identity (layout). Browse = residual only. Live: browseIdentityCount=0.
Renders title twice per card: data-viewer-sem-title-overlay AND data-viewer-sem-title. DOM titles array length 2 for one identity.

whereDuplicatesEnter.feed_data_same_shelf: Not observed live after hard refresh settle. Risk remains if buildHomeFeed URL-string dedupe misses absolute/relative twins before upsert, or if upsert skipped.
whereDuplicatesEnter.layout_projection: composeViewerShelfLayouts Featured remount + Trending shelf card (same identity, two DOM cards).

problem2_studio_choppiness.verdict: Freeze/choppiness trigger is ProductionCommandCenter + StudioWorkspaceLayout shared refresh fan-out amplified by a reactive schedule on every feedReels tick, dual listeners, 5s interval, and id-less recommendedActions merge that can collide on title keys.

amplifiers: ProductionCommandCenter + StudioWorkspaceLayout both registerCommandCenterRefreshListener → every flush rebuilds brief twice
Domain events: workflow-tasks-updated, teams-updated, notifications-updated, pipeline-updated, release-schedule-updated
$: refreshKey, ... evaluateNotificationTriggers → can emit notifications-updated → reschedule

collision_proof.when_titles_match: duplicate Svelte keys e.g. Attach reel to E01 twice → CASE_B
collision_proof.when_casing_differs: no key crash but near-duplicate actions Attach reel vs Attach Reel (CASE_A) — observed generator pair actionEngine vs series/workflowEngine

2) Preserve stable unique `id` on sentinel nextActions (do not strip recommendation/task ids) and key PCC each on `action.id` only.
